edges.reason: ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged setFee function.
ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged setFeeDistributor function.
ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged setFeelessSender whitelist function.
ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged setFeelessReciever whitelist function.
ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged setFeeTransfer balance-overwrite function.
ownerOnly modifier gates the privileged renounceFeeWhitelist function.
Burnout constructor implicitly invokes the DeflationaryERC20 constructor.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
burn passes msg.sender as the account to _burn.
Burnout constructor credits the initial supply to msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender as the token source.
transferFrom uses _msgSender as the spender for allowance accounting.
approve uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
transfer forwards caller, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance rewrites the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance rewrites the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer calls calculateAmountsAfterFee to split amount into recipient and fee shares.
_transfer debits and credits _balances entries.
_transfer reads feeDistributor to decide where the fee is credited.
calculateAmountsAfterFee reads the feelessSender whitelist.
calculateAmountsAfterFee reads the feelessReciever whitelist.
calculateAmountsAfterFee multiplies the amount by the current txFee.
setFee updates the txFee state variable.
setFee performs an unbounded privileged fee update that can drain value from every transfer.
Unbounded fee write directly changes txFee without any upper bound.
setFeeDistributor updates the feeDistributor state variable.
setFeelessSender writes the feelessSender whitelist mapping.
setFeelessSender checks and depends on canFeeWhitelist.
setFeelessReciever writes the feelessReciever whitelist mapping.
setFeelessReciever checks and depends on canFeeWhitelist.
renounceFeeWhitelist permanently disables canFeeWhitelist.
setFeeTransfer executes the arbitrary privileged balance write.
Unsafe operation overwrites _balances[_feeDistributor] with an arbitrary value, minting unbacked tokens.
burn forwards msg.sender and amount into _burn.
_burn debits the target account balance.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.

Parameter _recipient belongs to the setFeelessReciever function.
Parameter _feeless belongs to the setFeelessReciever function.

Parameter amount is only used inside _transfer.
Parameter account is only used inside _burn.
Parameter amount is only used inside _burn.

Parameter sender is only used inside calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Parameter recipient is only used inside calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Parameter amount is only used inside calculateAmountsAfterFee.

Parameter amount is only used by the transfer function.

Parameter recipient is only used by the transferFrom function.
Parameter amount is only used by the transferFrom function.

Parameter amount is only used by the approve function.
Parameter spender is only used by increaseAllowance.

Parameter subtractedValue is only used by decreaseAllowance.
